content.content:
The user asks: "Which actors played Spider-man in the latest live-action Spider-man movie, and who directed their respective Spider-man movies?" Need to identify the latest live-action Spider-Man movie (as of now). As of 2025, latest live-action Spider-Man movie likely "Spider-Man: Beyond the Spider-Verse"? That's animated. Live-action: "Spider-Man: No Way Home" was 2021. Then "Spider-Man: Across the Spider-Verse" is animated. There is also "Spider-Man: Freshman Year"? Not live-action. There may be upcoming "Spider-Man: The New Generation" but not out yet. The latest released live-action Spider-Man film is "Spider-Man: No Way Home" (2021) starring Tom Holland directed by Jon Watts. However there is also "Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse" animated. Also "Spider-Man: Homecoming" (2017) and "Spider-Man: Far From Home" (2019) starring Tom Holland directed by Jon Watts. If question asks "Which actors played Spider-man in the latest live-action Spider-man movie, and who directed their respective Spider-man movies?" Could interpret as: The latest live-action Spider-Man movie includes multiple actors playing Spider-Man (maybe different universes). In "Spider-Man: No Way Home", Tom Holland, Tobey Maguire, and Andrew Garfield appear as Spider-Man. So the question: which actors played Spider-Man in the latest live-action Spider-Man movie (No Way Home), and who directed their respective Spider-Man movies (i.e., each actor's own series). So answer: Tom Holland – directed by Jon Watts (Homecoming, Far From Home, No Way Home). Tobey Maguire – directed by Sam Raimi (Spider-Man 2002, 2004, 2007). Andrew Garfield – directed by Marc Webb (The Amazing Spider-Man 2012, The Amazing Spider-Man 2 2014). Also could mention that in No Way Home directors: Jon Watts directed the film overall. But they ask "who directed their respective Spider-man movies?" Likely meaning the directors of the movies where each actor starred as Spider-Man. So answer accordingly.

Provide concise answer.
